PAPER EXECUTION LAB

SIMULATED FILLS / NO ORDERS

Does a simple filter improve quoting? Replay the same raw events through always-quote and a fixed volatility / trend gate. See costs, inventory and what happens after each fill.

Fees are your assumption, not a fetched Kraken account rate. 1 bps = 0.01%. Default inventory 0.01 BTC + $10,000 cash, long only; quote size 0.001 BTC, refresh 60s, assumed latency 250ms. Clock offset bound ±1s; ambiguous near-arrival trades are excluded. Fixed gate: past 60s range ≤30 bps and drift ≤15 bps, with ≥30s warmup. Changed assumptions invalidate results.

Paper policy accounting comparison
NET EQUITY CHANGE / USD · INVENTORY MARKED, FEES INCLUDED━ ALWAYS QUOTE ━ FILTER

Markouts use received book observations, not guaranteed exchange-time returns; a delayed book can predate a fill. Positive markout means the observed price is in the fill's favor; negative suggests adverse selection. Each horizon includes only the first valid fresh book at or after its deadline; gaps and unfinished horizons remain unresolved. Excess vs hold subtracts the passive return of the same starting inventory. No forced exit is simulated.

BEHIND THE NUMBERS
DEMO uses synthetic BTC prices, binary odds, order-book depth, and daily windows. Paper fills are created only when you click an entry. They settle against the demo window reference at close; fees are excluded.
LIVE BTC SPOT connects to Coinbase's public BTC-USD ticker. The reference is the first price observed after connection or window rollover, not a Polymarket settlement price. All lower panels remain labeled illustrations; paper entries are disabled in live mode.
PROJECTED PATHS are configurable illustrative random walks, using a configurable volatility assumption. The model is uncalibrated, has no demonstrated trading edge, and does not use a Chainlink or PolyBolt feed. The median, p10 and p90 are computed across these generated samples, not calibrated confidence bounds. Path bias measures sample agreement, not forecast accuracy. Candles aggregate observed spot ticks within this tab; they are not exchange OHLC history. No Kronos model is connected.
FRESHNESS measures time since the last valid received tick. A feed older than 10 seconds is marked stale. Live disconnections remain visible and never silently switch to demo prices.
Paper sessions last for this tab only. Export fills before closing. This terminal has no wallet connection or order execution.
